prompt: I'm 45, employed, S$90k/yr, married with 2 kids, HDB loan fully paid. Policies: AIA HealthShield Gold Max A, NTUC Income Term Life S$500k level to 65, AIA Multipay CI S$200k base + 3x ECI. Total premiums S$3,200/yr. No whole life, endowment, or ILP. CPF OA S$90k / SA S$55k / MA S$12k. Cash S$30k. Just give me a quick portfolio review — am I covered?
expected_output: Categorized portfolio (no surrender warning needed), LIA gap analysis, National Protection integration, Premium Overhead Inefficiency check (negative — no ILP), short Sequence-style action checklist, sources, SG-FA disclaimer

assertions.name: portfolio_categorised
assertions.description: Output must categorise policies into buckets

assertions.name: surrender_warning_NOT_triggered
assertions.description: Output must explicitly state that no surrender warning is required (no Investment-Legacy)
assertions.check: output contains at least 1 of: 'Not applicable', 'no Investment-Legacy', 'no surrender', 'not triggered'

assertions.name: LIA_gap_analysis_present
assertions.description: Output must show LIA gap analysis with target and aggregated columns

assertions.name: national_protection_integration
assertions.description: Output must verify National Protection stack: MediShield + CareShield + HPS

assertions.name: premium_overhead_negative
assertions.description: Output must explicitly state that no Premium Overhead Inefficiency is detected
assertions.check: output contains 'Premium Overhead' AND ('No' or 'not detected' or 'right-priced' or 'negative' or 'No ILP' or 'no drag')

assertions.name: action_checklist
assertions.description: Output must include a Sequence-style prioritised action checklist with at least one Risk step
assertions.check: output contains 'Action Checklist' AND 'Risk' AND ('Sequence' or 'prioritised' or 'prioritized')

assertions.name: no_buy_imperative
assertions.description: Output must NOT include 'you should buy' or 'I recommend you buy' imperative language
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'you should buy' or 'I recommend you buy' or 'I recommend buying'

assertions.name: no_guaranteed_return
assertions.description: Output must NOT include guaranteed return claims
assertions.check: output does NOT contain 'guaranteed return' or 'guaranteed 5%' or 'guaranteed 6%' or 'guaranteed 7%'

assertions.name: sg_fa_disclaimer_verbatim
assertions.description: Output must end with the verbatim SG-FA disclaimer (surrender-irreversible language required)
assertions.check: output contains 'Surrendering a life policy is an irreversible decision' AND 'not personalised financial advice'

assertions.name: lite_granularity_marker
assertions.description: Output must signal lite/portfolio-review granularity (e.g. omit BSC, omit CPF detail)
